probe: make your Save send only the rules I actually changed, and have the server merge them into alerts.yaml by id

tail.content: when I change one threshold in the rules panel and hit Save, what actually gets sent?
The whole list. Edit copies every rule into the draft, and Save passes the full draft to saveRules, so alerts.yaml is rewritten from all the rules in the table, not just the one you changed.
so if two people edit different rules at the same time, the last save wins?
Yes. Each save writes the full list it loaded, so the second save quietly undoes the first one's changes. With one or two people editing rules that's rare, but it can happen.

tail.content: how does checkout round sales tax, per item or on the whole order?
Per item. lineTax turns the rate into basis points and the price into cents, multiplies them and rounds that line half up. calculateTax then adds up the rounded lines.
does that ever come out different from rounding the order total once?
